implementation_constraints: Bind initial FileInfo and captured bytes; never replace the snapshot identity after reopening.
Use fixed draft-root handles and verify root identity; reject links below the permitted root.
Preserve mismatched isolated sources; restore without overwriting and report the recovery path.
Never recursively delete draft or quarantine directories.
Keep CleanupWarning out of TOML, approval JSON and stdout; print it at both call sites before later errors.
Update stable capture rules and usage documentation.
limitations: No runtime proof for Windows sharing, hard-link support or recovery failure paths.
Design is not a cross-process locking protocol.
One supplemental worktree-glob search failed because the path did not exist; it was not repeated.
